name: Bac Kan Provincial Integrated Data Center (Trung tâm tích hợp dữ liệu tỉnh Bắc Kạn)
developer: Bac Kan Provincial People's Committee / VNPT
notes: Provincial integrated data center serving Bac Kan e-government; VNPT supplied infrastructure and hosts the province's smart operations center (IOC) launched March 2021. Small government facility; no commercial colocation identified in Bac Kan.

name: Bac Giang Provincial Integrated Data Center (TTTHDLT)
developer: Bac Giang Province (ICT Center / BGNet network)
notes: Provincial integrated data center (TTTHDLT) runs Bac Giang's BGNet government network; province also launched a smart city monitoring/operations center (IOC). Small government facility; Bac Giang is a major electronics manufacturing hub (Foxconn, Luxshare, Goertek) but no commercial colocation data center identified.

name: Bac Ninh Smart City Data Center (Trung tâm dữ liệu thành phố thông minh, VND 570bn)
developer: Bac Ninh Department of Information and Communications
notes: Provincial smart-city data center project (~VND 570 billion incl. cloud and integration platforms) under the Bac Ninh ICT department; announced September 2017 and still referenced as planned investment in 2023. No large commercial/hyperscale data center identified in Bac Ninh despite its VSIP and electronics industrial zones.

name: SAM Digital Hub (VSIP 3)
developer: Saigon Asset Management (SAM) with VSIP JV (Sembcorp Industries & Becamex IDC)
notes: Hyperscale data center (~USD 1.5bn) on >50 ha inside VSIP 3 Industrial Park, Binh Duong; planned capacity 150 MW, phased development with operations targeted within ~2 years of the March 2025 announcement; SAM also launched the USD 300m Vietnam Data Centre Fund (VDCF).

name: Viettel IDC Binh Duong (Song Than)
notes: Operational colocation data center ~25 km from Ho Chi Minh City, ~3,500 m2, ~USD 18m investment; one of Viettel IDC's national data centers (Hanoi, Hoa Lac, HCMC, Binh Duong, Da Nang). Capacity in MW not published.

name: Becamex IDC Data Center (VNTT)
developer: Becamex IDC / VNTT (Viet Nam Technology & Communication JSC)
notes: Data center built and operated via VNTT within the Becamex IDC smart-city/industry ecosystem in Binh Duong, supporting the smart operations center (IOC) and digital services for the province's industrial parks.

name: Binh Duong Provincial Data Center and Backup Data Center
developer: Binh Duong Provincial People's Committee (digital government program)
notes: Two government data centers (primary and disaster-recovery/backup) built under Binh Duong's e-government and smart-city program, hosting shared platforms and applications.

name: Binh Phuoc Provincial Integrated Data Center (Trung tâm tích hợp dữ liệu tỉnh Bình Phước)
notes: Provincial integrated data center in Dong Xoai (Tan Phu ward) put into operation under the 2021-2025 digital government project; information-security level approved by provincial Decision 1789/QD-UBND. Government facility; no commercial colocation identified.

name: PVCFC Data Center (Petrovietnam Ca Mau Fertilizer)
developer: PVCFC (Petrovietnam Fertilizer and Chemicals Corporation - Ca Mau)
notes: Enterprise data center of PVCFC in Ca Mau, recently upgraded and formally in operation to support the firm's digital transformation. Corporate IT facility, not commercial colocation; no third-party data center identified in Ca Mau.

name: Ha Nam Smart Operations Center (IOC) with provincial data platform
developer: Ha Nam Provincial People's Committee with VNPT
notes: Province-wide smart operations center launched 27 March 2020 integrating departmental systems and big-data analytics for e-government (Ha Nam was a national e-government pilot 2019-2020); operates on provincial data-center infrastructure. No standalone commercial colocation data center identified in Ha Nam.
